python3 -m unittest discover -s . -p test_*.py -v in the clean checkout tools/release: 11 tests OK, exit 0.

The first sandboxed invocation failed only at transport_spec with "socket creation failed"; the retained run outside the sandbox passed all five non-model gates, check-client-framing.py and relocated-binary-cli-smoke. Source identity was rechecked by the builder before packaging.

SHA256SUMS verified; embedded and external BUILD.json byte-identical and bound to tag v0.2.0-rc.1 at d737aa0; mirror --version prints v0.2.0-rc.1; model_interface_gen --help exits 2 with usage; ldd closure limited to libc/libm/libpthread/libdl/librt; archive contains only the expected six entries (four files, two directories); no Lean source, no credentials, no private keys.

No admitted Ubuntu 24.04 runtime with Lean absent is available on this coordinator (Ubuntu 26.04.1 LTS, WSL2, glibc 2.43). release.py check-archive was executed here and passed as a diagnostic only; it does not establish Ubuntu 24.04 runtime acceptance. Max required GLIBC symbol version observed in both binaries is 2.25, which is compatible with Ubuntu 24.04 glibc 2.39, but that is static evidence, not a runtime smoke.
